mapper.select: SELECT e.exam_id, e.class_id, c.name AS class_name, e.teacher_id, e.template_exam_id, e.title, e.exam_type, e.exam_mode, e.exam_round, e.status, e.exam_date, e.file_url, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM exams e LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = e.class_id WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.update: UPDATE exams SET class_id = #{classId}, title = #{title}, exam_type = #{examType}, exam_mode = #{examMode}, exam_round = #{examRound}, status = #{status}, exam_date = #{examDate}, file_url = #{fileUrl} WHERE exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.select: SELECT exam_id, class_id, teacher_id, template_exam_id, title, exam_type, exam_mode, exam_round, status, exam_date, file_url, created_at, updated_at FROM exams ORDER BY created_at DESC
